$comment: Performance budgets (#108), checked by `npm run budgets` in CI's budgets job. Raise a number only in a pull request that says why. Kernel and viewport baselines are a CI runner's own medians (2 to 3 times a laptop's); the check fails when a median is over its baseline by more than the tolerance.

bundle.$comment: KB gzipped, per chunk. The shell is the JavaScript index.html loads before first paint.

wasm.$comment: MB. OCCT is the opencascade.js build replicad ships (23 MB); the issue's 12 MB / 3.5 MB target needs a slimmer build of the same unmodified OCCT (#4, #50).

lighthouse.$comment: Desktop preset, Chromium with SwiftShader as CI runs it. Software WebGL compiles the view's shaders on the main thread (about 1 s of blocking time); with WebGL off the score is 100. The target is 0.85.
